complexity: Nested convex ternary refinement in the coordinate bounding box,80 steps per axis; O(n*80^2) time, O(1) auxiliary space. Numeric approximation, not exact rational.
domain: 1..50 two-coordinate integer points; each coordinate0..100. Duplicates allowed.
local_effects: readonly caller arguments; no result-to-input aliases; local requirement, not asserted official mutation rule

numeric_policy.batching: one case per invocation in both languages, prospectively frozen

result: Minimize the sum of Euclidean distances from a center to all supplied points; absolute error up to1e-5 is accepted.

source.authority: independently reviewed public official description; local paraphrase, not raw HTML
